content.heading: What Is Early Childhood Development?
content.body: Early childhood is a critical period of rapid physical, cognitive, language, social and emotional development. Parents can support development by providing responsive relationships, safe environments, play opportunities and meaningful conversations. Every child develops at an individual pace, so parents should focus on progress rather than comparison.
